profile.description: Fast, edge-optimized AI model from the Ministral-3 family that provides robust language and multimodal image capabilities in a compact footprint. It is specifically designed to run on a wide range of hardware, making it highly suitable for efficient, private local inference. The model offers native function calling, JSON output, and robust multilingual support across 40+ languages. Context window: 256K tokens
